test_case_name: Accept all cookies via the cookie banner

intents.intent: Click the 'ACCONSENTO' link to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted

test_case_name: Access cookie preferences from the cookie banner

intents.intent: Click the 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link to open cookie preferences
And then check that the cookie preferences page or modal is displayed

test_case_name: Close the cookie banner without accepting cookies

intents.intent: Click the button labeled 'Per accettare tutti i cookie, clicca sul pulsante “Acconsento”.' to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed without accepting cookies

test_case_name: Skip directly to the main content using accessibility button

intents.intent: Click the 'Passa al Contenuto' button to skip to the main content
And then check that the focus moves to the main content section

test_case_name: Skip directly to the menu using accessibility button

intents.intent: Click the 'Passa al Menù' button to skip to the menu

test_case_name: Skip directly to the footer using accessibility button

test_case_name: Open the search bar from the header

intents.intent: Click the button described as 'Open search' in the header
And then check that the search input with placeholder 'Cerca' is displayed and focused

test_case_name: Perform a search using the header search bar

intents.intent: Click the button described as 'Open search' in the header
Type $name into the input with placeholder 'Cerca'
Click the button described as 'Header search submit'
And then check that the search results page or section is displayed for $name
